queue.acceptance: Full criteria: https://github.com/lrnolivia/relay/issues/150 . (1) Reconcile live local/remote/claims, recover available later append-only research, preserve newer approved UI and maintain a requirement/code/test/evidence matrix. (2) Harden identity engine: persistent settings, exact safe fields, format-aware escaping/encoding, protected IDs/custom data, fresh preimages, unique checksummed backups, atomic/journaled apply and verified restore; unknown is not compatible. (3) Shared testable provider/path/game adapters, explicit game/distribution/runtime/account identities, scoped Windows Known Folders/Proton/Wine/XDG/Flatpak discovery, pinned offline catalog, fail-closed unsupported semantics. (4) Lite Review/Go use immutable plans; local/shared .gamebridge generations/endpoint baselines, content-based three-way sync, PLAN_STALE, preserved conflicts, locks/quiescence, verified backup/publication/recovery. Missing/inaccessible/uninitialized is not empty; no timestamp-only winners/deletion propagation. (5) Main Library/Profiles/Migration/Backups covers Steam, Xbox/Game Pass/MS Store, Epic/EOS, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Rockstar, Battle.net, Amazon, itch, PlayStation PC, Heroic, Lutris, Bottles, Proton/Wine, native/Flatpak/manual/shared installs. Real discovery and capability fixtures; unknown games visible, no provider-label stubs. (6) Validated direct-copy/container/game-adapter migration: WGS extraction != conversion != installation != game-load verification. Main cross-store edges individually proven; no account/DRM/auth bypass or generic binary rewrites. Source/destination backups, restore and cloud conflict evidence. (7) Main native GTK4/libadwaita, Qt6/Kirigami, WinUI3; compact Lite Windows/Linux; approved family design without graphics scope. Safe legacy-ID migration to separate fi.loew.GameBridgeLite/fi.loew.GameBridge; independent Flatpak/AppImage/Windows packages, package-manager-safe updates, GPL-3.0-or-later/notices, CI and verified remote artifacts. (8) After core safety: community registry, metadata previews, duplicate detection, cross-device sync, opt-in scheduled backups/history, supported config migration, cloud comparison, bundles/recipes/new-PC restore. Track actual prerequisites; no silently dropped ambitions. (9) Exact-artifact tests: safe names/settings, provider identity, bidirectional sync/conflicts/stale/first-run/missing endpoints, link/case/Unicode/filesystem boundaries, concurrent writers, interruption/recovery/corruption/full disk, native UI and package upgrades. PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT RUN distinct; no fabricated runtime/save-load evidence. (10) All M0–M7 requirements accounted before umbrella closure; incomplete/protected capabilities explicit. Actual implementation uses bounded milestone claims and draft PRs under current coordination/QA rules, no force-push or bypassed checks.
